verdict.rationale: WezTerm ships an official, documented `wezterm cli` subcommand that spawns programs and manipulates tabs and panes in a running GUI or mux instance. A runtime probe verified a fully headless agent-style loop (spawn, send-text, get-text, list) with no GUI session, and a community user confirms using get-text to dump scrollback. Missing for 10: no evidence of documented machine-readable output formats or AI-agent-specific guidance for the CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The _cli_ subcommand interacts with a running wezterm GUI or multiplexer instance, and can be used to spawn programs and manipulate tabs and panes.
